column2: Item
When no metafield is configured on the delivery customization, the function returns no operations and no delivery options are hidden.
When targetStrings is an empty array [], the function returns no operations regardless of all other configuration or cart state.
When the current shop local time is before the configured startDateTime, the function returns no operations.
When the current shop local time is at or past the configured endDateTime, the function returns no operations.
When sentinel datetimes are used (1970-01-01T00:00:00 start / 2099-12-31T23:59:59 end), the function is always active and hides matched delivery options on every qualifying checkout.
When startDateTime is the sentinel 1970-01-01T00:00:00 and a real endDateTime is set, the function is active for any checkout occurring before that end date.

When only startDateTime is configured (no endDateTime in the metafield), the function is active for any checkout occurring after that start date. The GraphQL query defaults endDateTime to 2099-12-31T23:59:59.

Date/time fields stored in the metafield config are evaluated against the shop's local time via shop.localTime.dateTimeAfter / dateTimeBefore — verify on staging that a checkout within the configured window is affected and one outside it is not.
When customerTags is not configured (null or absent from the metafield), the function applies threshold logic to all checkouts regardless of customer identity or login state.
When customerTags is configured and the logged-in customer has at least one tag matching the configured list, the function proceeds to threshold checks.
When customerTags is configured and the logged-in customer has no matching tag, the function returns no operations.
When customerTags is configured and the buyer is a guest (unauthenticated, no customer account), the function returns no operations.
When customerTags is configured and buyerIdentity is entirely absent (null, not merely unauthenticated), the function returns no operations.
When cartThreshold is configured and the cart subtotal is strictly below it, the function returns no operations.
When cartThreshold is configured and the cart subtotal exactly equals the threshold value, the condition is met (>= behavior) and the function proceeds.
When cartThreshold is not configured, the function proceeds to percent threshold checks regardless of cart total.
When percentThreshold is not configured, the function hides all delivery options matching targetStrings whenever all prior gates pass — no per-line-item discount check is required.

When percentThreshold is configured and at least one cart line item's effective discount ((subtotalAmount - totalAmount) / subtotalAmount * 100, rounded to 2dp) is strictly above the threshold, the function hides matched delivery options. A line exactly at the threshold rounds to the threshold value and does not trigger hiding — assumed to be the sitewide rate.
column3: Rounding to 2dp prevents floating-point representation errors — e.g. 224.55 / 1497.0 * 100 evaluates to slightly above 15.0 in f64 even though the math is exactly 15%. Without rounding this incorrectly triggers hiding.

column2: When percentThreshold is configured and a line item has both a line-level discount and an order-level discount code, totalAmount reflects only the line-level portion — Shopify does not include order-level codes in totalAmount. The order-level discount is automatically excluded from the threshold calculation.
When percentThreshold is configured and every line item's effective discount (via totalAmount) is at or below the threshold, the function returns no operations.
When percentThreshold is configured but the cart has no line items, the function returns no operations (.any() on an empty iterator returns false).
When the cart has multiple line items and at least one has an effective discount strictly above the percent threshold, all delivery options matching targetStrings are hidden.
When no delivery option title contains any configured targetString as a substring, the function returns no operations and no options are hidden.
When multiple targetStrings are configured and multiple delivery options each match a different string, every matched option is hidden in a single response.
Title matching is case-sensitive: a targetString that differs from the delivery option title only in letter casing does not produce a match.
Title matching uses substring containment: a targetString that is a partial substring of a longer delivery option title still triggers a hide operation for that option.

Full integration scenario: an outdoor-pro-tagged customer, cart subtotal >= $300, with at least one line item discounted strictly above 15% at the line level, within an active date window → "Free Shipping Over $300" is hidden and "Standard Shipping" remains visible.

A retail customer (authenticated, no matching tag) with an otherwise qualifying cart (>= cart threshold, >= percent threshold, active date window) does NOT have the free shipping option hidden when customerTags is configured.
When devMode is true and the buyer is an authenticated customer with the rs-dev tag, the function runs through its full logic and hides matched delivery options.
When devMode is true and the buyer is a guest (not authenticated), the function returns no operations.
When devMode is true and the buyer is authenticated but does not have the rs-dev tag, the function returns no operations.
When devMode is false or absent, the dev-mode gate is bypassed entirely and all customers are subject to the normal function logic (no rs-dev tag required).

All seven configuration fields (targetStrings, cartThreshold, percentThreshold, customerTags, startDateTime, endDateTime, devMode) can be set and updated on the staging store via the GraphiQL app without re-deploying the extension — changes take effect on the next checkout.
Delivery options that do not match any configured targetString remain visible in checkout even when the function hides other options in the same delivery group.

Multi-line cart where Shopify applies the sitewide sale rate to all line items (sitewide beats pro rate on every line) — effective discount on every line rounds to exactly the threshold → free shipping NOT hidden.
column3: Test setup: 1 tent + 1 pack (qty 1 each) pro-member tagged. Shopify applies 15% sitewide to both because it's the higher discount. Function should allow free shipping.

column2: Multi-line cart where Shopify applies the pro discount to at least one line item (pro rate beats sitewide) — effective discount on that line exceeds the threshold → free shipping hidden.
column3: Test setup: 1 tent + 2 packs (qty 1 tent 2 packs) pro-member tagged. Shopify determines pro discount is greater on the pack line. Function should hide free shipping. Note: qty affects which discount Shopify applies — the function only checks the resulting line discount percentage not qty.
